purpose: Missing skill guilds and production hubs not already fully modeled in data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json: Cooks' Guild, Runecrafting Guild/Wizards' Tower, Max Guild skill portals, named Invention Guild machines, POH portal towns and aquarium/prawnbroker, player-owned ports skilling rewards under Asgarnia Arc mapping, Manor Farm / Farming Guild reputation, Summoning large-obelisk premium sites, and Anachronia base-camp structure reward detail. Skips exact existing ids (crafting-guild, invention-guild, invention-machines-guild, base-camp hub row, farmers-market-master-farmer, fort buildings, runespan-portal/outfits, taverley-burthorpe hub).

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in Equilibrium taxonomy. region_hints marks multi-portal or multi-destination networks. required_regions only when every listed region is needed. Quest auto-completion and League overrides apply separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise permanent infrastructure, reward shops, offline machines, and self-sufficient tool/food unlocks. Do not mirror every shop stock line.
policy.rate_rule: Do not invent XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets.
policy.skip_rule: Warriors' Guild is combat-token / defender infrastructure — omitted. Clan Avatar XP is non-regional — omitted. RS3 has no Hunter Guild (Manor Farm is Farming Guild; BGH uses Anachronia Hunter Lodge). Crafting Guild, Invention Guild shell, cross-region:invention-machines-guild, anachronia:base-camp, kandarin:farmers-market-master-farmer, misthalin:runespan-portal, asgarnia:taverley-burthorpe-skilling-hub already exist — do not re-emit those exact ids; only expand thin gaps with new ids.

skipped.reason: Token / defender combat infrastructure only; no skilling-token production path for Equilibrium skilling catalog.
Clan-system XP aura, not a regional skilling hub.
Does not exist in RS3. Closest Hunter infrastructure: Anachronia Hunter Lodge + Big Game Hunter; Kandarin Piscatoris / skillchompa sites already modeled.
Already fully modeled (entry, production stations, mine, bank diary upgrade, cape, inventor workbench / starbloom tailor).
Guild shell and machine power rules already exist; this file only adds a named machine list under a new id.
Hub row exists; this file adds structure-tier reward detail as a new id.

Chef's hat, sous chef's toque, Cooking cape, max cape, or hard Varrock achievements for entry without headgear

Romily Weaklax pie stall and pie-bake orders

activity_additions.name: Max Guild (Prifddinas skill portals)
requirements: Plague's End for Prifddinas access
Garden: any level 99 or wearable Quest Cape
Tower interior: max cape
Destination-specific skill/quest gates for each portal tune

Skilling destinations include: active crystal tree, Jadinko Lair, Lava Flow Mine, Living Rock Caverns, brilliant/radiant/luminous/incandescent wisp colonies, Runespan upper floor, Tree Gnome Stronghold, Zanaris fairy ring, Puro-Puro, Prifddinas Waterfall, Invention Guild, Menaphos VIP skilling area, Deep Sea Fishing hub, overgrown idols, Anachronia Dinosaur Farm (5,000 beans market unlock)

Rhodri Dail potion/flask decanting and crystal enchant inside the tower
Crystal acorn gift on first tower entry for crystal tree growth

Portal use still requires the destination skill/quest; Max Guild is a Tirannwn routing hub, not a free unlock of every destination region. Prefer existing activity rows for LRC, DSF, Invention Guild, Ranch Out of Time when ranking those methods.

activity_additions.name: Invention Guild named machine room
activity_additions.location: Invention Guild basement / back room north-east of Falador
requirements: 60 Invention for machine tutorial and first hotspots (boostable to build)
Six machine hotspots + one generator hotspot; machines only buildable in this room
Generator tiers: Simple 60 Inv (100 power), Large 80 (125), Jumbo 102 (160); Fort Forinthry tier-3 Workshop +40 power to 200
unlocks: Auto disassembler (60 Inv, 30 power) / Auto disassembler mk. II (81 Inv, 40 power) — offline disassemble for components
Alchemiser (72 Inv, 20 power; max 2) / Alchemiser mk. II (108 Inv, 55 power) — offline High Alchemy (mk. II nature only)
Partial potion producer (90 Inv, 20 power) / Partial potion producer DX (114 Inv, 50 power) — clean herbs to unfinished potions + vials of water
Automatic hide tanner (93 Inv, 25 power) / Optimised hide tanner (111 Inv, 50 power) — free hide tanning including dinosaur hide
Plank maker (99 Inv, 30 power) / High capacity plank maker (117 Inv, 65 power) — logs to planks without coins
Hourly machine tick while logged out while machine charge and inputs remain; divine charges → 3,000 machine charge each
activity_additions.notes: Named list expansion for planner checklists. Does not replace cross-region:invention-machines-guild (power math, Fort bonus, workbench vs hotspot distinction). Full five tier-2 machines need 260 power; jumbo+Fort maxes at 200 — layout trade-offs are mandatory. BoB inventory inaccessible inside the guild.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia for machine hotspots. Misthalin optional for Fort Workshop +40 power only.

activity_additions.location: Port Sarim portal (primary); also Prif / Menaphos portals and Fort Command Centre ports table
requirements: Members; 90 unboostable in at least one ports skill to progress voyages (Agility, Construction, Cooking, Divination, Dungeoneering, Fishing, Herblore, Hunter, Prayer, Runecrafting, Slayer, Thieving)
Workshop upgrade after unlocking The Hook region for scroll crafting
Scroll pieces via focused scroll voyages; trade goods soft-cap 250 stored
unlocks: Skilling scrimshaw scrolls (pocket slot): log-splitting, rock-crushing, tree-shaking, gem-finding, whopper-baiting, casket-salvaging, memory-crushing, energy-gathering (plus combat scrimshaws out of skilling priority)
Eastern soups: rocktail soup (93 Cooking) and sailfish soup (99 Cooking) from spices + fish in the port Workshop

Captain's Log port teleport; office tiers unlock extra ship slots; warehouse tiers boost voyage rewards

activity_additions.name: Player-owned house Aquarium and Prawnbroker
requirements: 63 Construction for bathysphere + oyster hunter diving suit + driftwood prawnbroker (boostable build; settings toggle needs unboosted 63)

Golden fish eggs and prawn balls from fishing / Motherlode Maw mystery egg path for perk points

Landmark decorations: +2% base Fishing XP and higher golden-egg chance at matching spots (Catherby, LRC, Otto's Grotto, Piscatoris, Fishing Guild, Shilo) once stored in bathysphere

Prawnbroker prawn perks (15 for completionist; 18 perk points for trimmed): denser prawn balls, baitless fishing, featherless fly fishing with species choice, barbarian baitless, great white shark fishing, sushi Cooking recipes, pennies/pounds duration, Sayln the Shark pet

activity_additions.name: Anachronia base camp structure tier rewards
requirements: Base camp tutorial with Giles
Town Hall gates higher building tiers; skill gates on Spa / Hunter Lodge / Slayer Lodge / Player Lodge are unboostable
Worker count: 10 base + Sleeping Quarters (+5/+15/+30) + Fort Command Centre T2/T3 (+5/+5) → max 70
unlocks: Town Hall T1–T3: unlocks all same-tier buildings; compacted resource deposits 100/200/400; visitor stores (general → armour/weapon → gem/rune)
Storehouse T1–T3: resource caps 25k / 80k / 150k per type (from 5k pre-storehouse)
Sleeping Quarters T1–T3: +5 / +15 / +30 workers (900 / 1,800 / 3,600 resources per hour at full assignment, 60 per worker per hour)
Spa T1–T3 (40/70/90 Agility): +5% / +7% / +10% Agility XP on Anachronia; Oo'glog-style salt/thermal/mud pools; T3 longer/stronger pool effects (needs essential oils)
Hunter Lodge T1–T3 (40/70/90 Hunter): +10% BGH Woodcutting resources; +2.4s BGH catch timer; remove one frog type at BGH start (reinforced dinosaur pelt at T3)
Slayer Lodge T1–T3 (40/70/90 Slayer): +1% / +3% / +6% damage on Anachronia; T3 helmet stand (combat row lives elsewhere)
Player Lodge T1–T3 (40/70/90 Construction): +10% building resource finds; T2 restore HP/prayer/summoning + Anachronia tablet house-tele convert; T3 skillcape rack (support row elsewhere)
Bank chest upgrade, lodestone, remote totem access point
activity_additions.notes: Detail expansion under existing anachronia:base-camp hub id. Prefer this row for structure reward math; keep the hub row for economy overview. Fort Command Centre worker bonuses are Misthalin/Forinthry pressure on max workers, not Anachronia-local buildings.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Anachronia. Fort worker bonuses optional Misthalin pressure.
